reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) discusses general MCE challenges and HEA properties in a different alloy system (FeCoNiCrPd), mentioning homogenization improves magnetocaloric properties, but provides no specific support for the key premises about nanoscale inhomogeneities, their modulation of transition temperatures, or the effect of annealing in FeMnNiGeSi-type alloys.
premises: Nanoscale chemical and lattice inhomogeneities exist in as-deposited FeMnNiGeSi-type HEAs
These inhomogeneities locally modulate magnetic exchange and magnetostructural transition temperature
This leads to a narrow, hysteretic transition in the as-deposited state
Annealing can homogenize short-range chemical order in these alloys
Homogenization broadens the distribution of local transition temperatures and reduces hysteresis
